records.text: There, we live in a world of tremendous cowardice. Melly writes, "Like this, even though it might not be much, to yell out to Charlie (Charlie Kirk) that we will never give up and he is beyond loved." I think he meant like, like this comment or like this episode, and I think he knows he is loved. It's just not by the people that he thought he was loved by, which is sad. But more people than ever, I think, know his story, and that's what he wanted to do. He wanted to impact the world, and he did. Abigail writes, "Did you see Ben Shapiro getting called out"
records.speaker: Candace Owens
